name: ja_cn_revenue_today_event4_20260821
sql:
WITH UserBlacklist AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#varchar_id" AS account_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_4
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users')
),
PayEvents AS (
    SELECT
        v."#account_id" AS account_id,
        CAST(v."$part_date" AS DATE) AS pay_date,
        CAST(v.payload.curamt AS DOUBLE) AS source_amount,
        v.payload.cur AS currency,
        COALESCE(ex.exchange, 1.0) AS exchange_rate
    FROM ta.v_event_4 v
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange ex
      ON v."$part_date" = ex.ex_date
     AND v.payload.cur = ex.currency
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist ub ON v."#account_id" = ub.account_id
    WHERE v."$part_date" = '2026-08-21'
      AND v."$part_event" = 'PURCHASE'
      AND (v.payload.validationtype IS NULL OR v.payload.validationtype <> 'SANDBOX_RECEIPT')
      AND ub.account_id IS NULL
      AND CAST(v.payload.curamt AS DOUBLE) > 0
),
Agg AS (
    SELECT pay_date,
           SUM(source_amount / exchange_rate) AS revenue_usd,
           COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,
           COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) AS payers,
           COUNT(DISTINCT currency) AS currencies,
           MAX(exchange_rate) AS max_exchange_rate
    FROM PayEvents
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CAST(DATE '2026-08-21' AS VARCHAR) AS date,
       ROUND(COALESCE(revenue_usd, 0.0), 2) AS revenue_usd,
       COALESCE(valid_orders, 0) AS valid_orders,
       COALESCE(payers, 0) AS payers,
       COALESCE(currencies, 0) AS currencies,
       max_exchange_rate
FROM Agg
RIGHT JOIN (SELECT DATE '2026-08-21' AS pay_date) d ON Agg.pay_date = d.pay_date
